create.name: Robert Moss
create.bio:
Born in Australia, Robert Moss is a storyteller, author and dream teacher who created Active Dreaming, his own blend of shamanic practice and modern dreamwork. He had three near-death experiences as a child; he sees them as his first openings to other realms, and he later wrote about them in a memoir. He once taught ancient history as a lecturer at the Australian National University, and has also worked as a journalist, poet and independent scholar.

In Active Dreaming, dreams are approached as real experiences and journeys rather than simply as material for analysis. Moss teaches how to re-enter a dream, how to travel consciously in dreams and how to share them in small groups, as well as kairomancy, his word for noticing signs and synchronicity in waking life. Conscious Dreaming, Dreamgates, The Secret History of Dreaming, Sidewalk Oracles and Growing Big Dreams are among his more than a dozen books. He gives workshops around the world, offers a three-year training for those who want to teach Active Dreaming, and has recorded many self-paced courses with The Shift Network on lucid and shamanic dreaming, ancient dream traditions, and dreams of death and the afterlife.

books.title: Conscious Dreaming: A Spiritual Path for Everyday Life
books.author: Robert Moss
books.description: Moss's first book on dreamwork, setting out a step-by-step approach to understanding and working with dreams drawn from shamanic cultures and modern practice.

books.title: Active Dreaming: Journeying Beyond Self-Limitation to a Life of Wild Freedom
books.author: Robert Moss
books.description: A practical guide to Active Dreaming: re-entering dreams, sharing them, and using dream guidance and imagination in daily life.

books.title: Dreamgates: Exploring the Worlds of Soul, Imagination, and Life Beyond Death
books.author: Robert Moss
books.description: Exercises and stories for conscious dream travel, soul remembering and exploring the realms beyond physical death.

books.title: The Secret History of Dreaming
books.author: Robert Moss
books.description: A history of how dreams have shaped events, cultures and creative work, from the ancient world to the present.

books.title: The Boy Who Died and Came Back: Adventures of a Dream Archaeologist in the Multiverse
books.author: Robert Moss
books.description: Moss's spiritual memoir, from his childhood near-death experiences in Australia to a life of dream travel and teaching.

books.title: Sidewalk Oracles: Playing with Signs, Symbols, and Synchronicity in Everyday Life
books.author: Robert Moss
books.description: A playful guide to noticing signs and synchronicity in waking life, with games and practices Moss calls kairomancy.

books.title: Growing Big Dreams: Manifesting Your Heart’s Desires Through Twelve Secrets of the Imagination
books.author: Robert Moss
books.description: Moss's twelve secrets of the imagination for growing a bigger vision for your life and bringing it into the world.

books.title: Dreaming the Soul Back Home: Shamanic Dreaming for Healing and Becoming Whole
books.author: Robert Moss
books.description: An approach to soul recovery through shamanic dreaming, showing readers how to become shamans of their own souls.

books.title: The Dreamer's Book of the Dead: A Soul Traveler's Guide to Death, Dying, and the Other Side
books.author: Robert Moss
books.description: A guide to meeting the departed in dreams and preparing for death, drawing on Active Dreaming and older traditions.

books.title: The Three "Only" Things: Tapping the Power of Dreams, Coincidence, and Imagination
books.author: Robert Moss
books.description: How dreams, coincidence and imagination, often dismissed as 'only' things, can guide everyday choices.

courses.title: The Power of Active Dreaming
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced introduction to Active Dreaming: remembering dreams, working with them and bringing their guidance into waking life.

courses.title: Dreaming Your Mythic Life
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced course on finding your bigger life story through dreamwork and connecting with archetypal sources of courage and creativity.

courses.title: Shamanic Lucid Dreaming
courses.description: A twelve-module self-paced training in shamanic lucid dreaming and following your soul's calling. It includes the seven-module introductory programme.

courses.title: Embrace Death, Dying & the Afterlife Using Shamanic Practices & Dreamwork
courses.description: A thirteen-module self-paced training in dreamwork practices for meeting death as an ally and glimpsing the afterlife in dreams. It includes the seven-module introductory programme.

courses.title: Reclaiming Ancient Dreamways
courses.description: A twelve-module self-paced course in dream practices from Aboriginal, Egyptian, Celtic, Greek and Native American traditions.

courses.title: Adventures in Dream Travel
courses.description: A self-paced course in conscious dream travel and exploring other realms through Active Dreaming.

courses.title: Time Travel & Reality Creation in the Multiverse
courses.description: A self-paced course using dreamwork and imagination to explore parallel lives, other times and the creation of new possibilities.

courses.title: Dream Journeys Beyond the Veil
courses.description: A self-paced course on dreaming with the departed and exploring the realms beyond physical life.

courses.title: Active Dreaming: The Essential Training
courses.description: A self-paced training in the core techniques of Active Dreaming, including dream re-entry, dream sharing and conscious dream travel.

courses.title: Shamanic Dreaming With Goddesses of Rebirth for Courage, Clarity & True Fulfillment
courses.description: A self-paced course in shamanic dreaming with goddess figures of rebirth from several traditions.

free_resources.title: Dreaming in the Many Worlds (Substack)
free_resources.description: Robert Moss's newsletter of essays and stories on dreaming, storytelling and personal myth. Free to subscribe, with an optional paid tier.

free_resources.title: The Robert Moss Blog
free_resources.description: Moss's long-running blog of dream reports, practices and reflections on synchronicity and the imagination, free to read.

flags: Follower counts could not be read for any main account (Facebook count hidden, no own YouTube channel); local_hero is a placeholder from missing data and doesn't match his reputation as a bestselling author with a dozen-plus books.

His website mossdreams.com returned 403 (blocked) to every request, so his own workshops, contact page and any published email could not be checked; a human should look at mossdreams.com for an email or contact form.
Facebook URL (facebook.com/RobertMossBooks) is titled 'Robert Moss Books' and is listed for him on a radio interview page (ksqd.org), but its contents couldn't be read; please confirm.

Kept the book Dreaming the Soul Back Home: Shamanic Dreaming for Healing and Becoming Whole: 'healing' in the subtitle names no condition (soul recovery), but it is borderline; drop it if you want this strict.
website_url and booking_url point to mossdreams.com, which is widely cited as his site but returned 403 to us.
All videos are interviews or talks on other channels (he has no channel of his own); he is the main speaker in each.
Shift prices change with promotions: several courses are shown at sale prices (e.g. The Power of Active Dreaming $297 USD, regular $347 USD).

The School of Imaginal Healing & Dream Growing ($947 USD) and School of Imaginal Healing ($497 USD): healing-focused titles, left out as borderline under the health-claim rule.

Other Shift self-paced courses (Dreaming Wide Awake, Quantum Dreaming, The Soul Recovery Training, Dreaming the Soul Back Home, Dancing With the Bear, Living Your Mythic Edge, The Dreamer's School of Soul, Dreaming into the Dreamtime, Shamanic Approaches to Death, Dying and the Afterlife, The School of Dream Growing): left out because of the 10-offering cap (some may be older archive courses).
His own in-person workshops and three-year teacher training: not checked because mossdreams.com was blocked.

Books Mysterious Realities (1608685381) and Dreaming True (0671785303): left out only because of the 10-book cap. She Who Dreams (Wanda Burch, with Robert Moss): title about healing, and he is not the main author.

Video 'Active Dreaming: How to Work with Dreams for Healing & Guidance' (FIELD DYNAMICS): healing in title, borderline; Shift Network channel videos (belong on the hub); clips under 2 minutes; reuploads by third parties (CJ Liu, Jack Downey).
sprint.tier_override: Raised from local_hero to luminary by the owner (31 Oct 2026) under the editorial-stature rule: a major author in his field (Active Dreaming; bestselling books on dreams and shamanism). Readable follower counts alone would give local_hero.
